description: Implementation of network error handling functions, including error string conversions, error classification, and mapping file errors to network errors.

methods.name: ErrorToString
methods.description: Converts an error code to its string representation prefixed with 'net::'.

methods.name: ExtendedErrorToString
methods.description: Returns a string for extended errors, especially for QUIC protocol errors.

methods.name: ErrorToShortString
methods.description: Returns a short string for common error codes.

methods.name: IsCertificateError
methods.description: Checks if an error code is a certificate error.

methods.name: IsClientCertificateError
methods.description: Checks if an error code is related to client certificate issues.

methods.name: IsHostnameResolutionError
methods.description: Checks if an error code indicates a hostname resolution failure.

methods.name: IsRequestBlockedError
methods.description: Checks if an error code indicates a request was blocked.

methods.name: FileErrorToNetError
methods.description: Maps a file error to a corresponding network error code.
